from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper: its title and the other provided papers it references."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of this paper as written in the document header")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
